questions.question: Neither of the boys ________ able to attend the leadership camp last weekend.
questions.explanation: "Neither of + 复数名词" 作主语时，谓语动词通常遵循单数原则；且由时间状语 "last weekend" 可知句子为一般过去时，故选用 was。

questions.question: The student ________ project won first prize was praised by the principal.
questions.explanation: 空格后有名词 project，且 student 与 project 之间为所属关系（该学生的作品），因此定语从句需用关系代词 whose 表所属。

questions.question: Mr Lim asked the pupils to ________ the unfamiliar words in the dictionary.
questions.explanation: 短语动词搭配辨析："look up" 意为“查阅（字典、参考书）”；"look into" 是调查；"look after" 是照顾；"look down" 是轻视。查字典用 look up。

questions.question: Ethan seldom complains about the heavy schoolwork, ________?
questions.explanation: 反义疑问句考点：陈述部分含有否定副词 seldom（很少），反问部分应采用肯定式；动词 complains 为一般现在时第三人称单数，故助动词用 does，反义疑问句为 does he。

questions.question: ________ the heavy downpour, the children continued playing in the park.
questions.explanation: "the heavy downpour" 为名词短语。Although 和 Even though 后面必须接完整的从句；Despite 为介词，后接名词、代词或动名词，意为“尽管”，符合语境。

questions.question: The strict teacher made all the students ________ their desks before the recess bell rang.
questions.explanation: 使役动词 make 的用法："make sb. do sth."（让某人做某事），其后宾语补足语须用不带 to 的动词不定式（即动词原形）。

questions.question: While Mei Ling ________ her homework, the telephone suddenly rang.
questions.explanation: 过去进行时与一般过去时并用考点：主句描述过去瞬间发生的动作（rang），while 引导的从句表示过去某个特定时刻正在进行的动作，用 was doing。

questions.question: There is only ________ milk left in the carton, so we need to buy more.
questions.explanation: milk 为不可数名词，修饰不可数名词用 little 或 a little。根据 "only" 以及句意“还有一点点”，选用带有肯定意味的 "a little"。

questions.question: Mr Tan, together with his two daughters, ________ to London tonight.
questions.explanation: 主谓一致考点：主语后面跟有 "together with / as well as / along with" 等介词短语时，谓语动词的人称和数取决于前面的主语 Mr Tan（单数）；再由 tonight 可知用现在进行时表将来，选 is flying。

questions.question: Jia En is very keen on ________ up a new martial art this holiday.
questions.explanation: 介词后接动名词形式。固定搭配 "be keen on doing sth." 意为“热衷于做某事”，介词 on 后面必须用动词的 -ing 形式。

questions.question: Let's visit the new science centre this weekend, ________?
questions.explanation: 祈使句的反义疑问句：以 "Let's" 开头的祈使句，表示提出共同的建议，其简短反问统一使用 "shall we"。

questions.question: Visitors ________ not take photographs inside this art exhibition hall.
questions.explanation: 情态动词考点："must not" 表示“严禁/切勿”，符合展馆禁止拍照的规则约束；"need not" 仅表示“没有必要”。

questions.question: If it rains heavily tomorrow, our outdoor sports day ________ cancelled.
questions.explanation: 第一类条件句（First Conditional）：if 引导的条件状语从句用一般现在时（rains），主句则用一般将来时（will be），表示将来很可能发生的情况。

questions.question: The teacher congratulated Marcus ________ winning the national storytelling competition.
questions.explanation: 固定介词搭配："congratulate someone on (doing) something" 意为“因某事向某人道贺”，介词须用 on。

questions.question: Either the class monitor or the committee members ________ the sound system for tomorrow's concert.
questions.explanation: 就近一致原则：由 "Either... or..." 连接两个并列主语时，谓语动词的单复数取决于靠近它的主语 members（复数）；再根据 "tomorrow" 可知用进行时表即将进行的动作，故选 are testing。

questions.question: The Scouts managed to pitch the large canvas tents all by ________.
questions.explanation: 反身代词考点：主语是 "The Scouts"（复数第三人称），对应反身代词为 themselves。"by oneself" 意为“独自/靠自己”。

questions.question: Uncle David ________ in Clementi since he moved from Malaysia five years ago.
questions.explanation: 由 "since + 过去时间点/过去从句" 可知，动作从过去持续到现在，主句必须使用现在完成时 (has/have + 过去分词)，主语为单数，用 has lived。

questions.question: The damaged bridge ________ by a team of skilled workers last month.
questions.explanation: 被动语态考点：主语 "The damaged bridge" 与 repair 为被动关系，且有明确过去时间状语 "last month"，需用一般过去时的被动语态 "was/were + done"，主语单数用 was repaired。

questions.question: All the pupils are looking forward to ________ their pen pals in Australia.
questions.explanation: 固定动词短语用法："look forward to" 中的 to 是介词，并非动词不定式符号，后面必须接动名词（V-ing），意为“盼望做某事”。

questions.question: You will not qualify for the finals ________ you put in more effort during training.
questions.explanation: 连词辨析："unless" 相当于 "if not"，意为“除非”。整句意为“除非你在训练中付出更多努力，否则你无法获得决赛资格”。

questions.question: Nobody knew the correct answer to the difficult riddle, ________?
questions.explanation: 反义疑问句考点：当主语是不定代词 nobody/no one 时，附加疑问句的主语代词通常用 they；同时 nobody 表否定，反问部分用肯定式 did they。

questions.question: The author ________ you met at the book fair yesterday is my mother's friend.
questions.explanation: 定语从句先行词为 "The author"（人），并在从句 "you met [author]" 中充当宾语，规范英语中使用宾格关系代词 whom。

questions.question: Each of the participants ________ given a commemorative medal at the end of the marathon.
questions.explanation: "Each of + 复数名词" 作主语时，谓语动词视为主格单数；由语境已完成的事件可知用一般过去时，选 was。

questions.question: Please remember ________ the air conditioner before you lock the door.
questions.explanation: "remember to do sth." 意为“记住去做某事（事情尚未做）”；"remember doing sth." 意为“记得曾做过某事”。句中提示锁门前先关空调，属于尚未执行的动作，用 to switch。

questions.question: The annual sports day was ________ due to bad weather and will be held next Friday instead.
questions.explanation: 短语动词辨析："put off" 意为“推迟、延期”；"put out" 是扑灭；"put on" 是穿上/上演；"put away" 是收拾整理。根据 "held next Friday instead" 可知是延期。

questions.question: Between the two twins, Jeremy is definitely the ________ one.
questions.explanation: 两者之间的比较用比较级："the + 比较级 + of the two" 表示“两者中较……的一个”，故选用 quieter。

questions.question: We watched the magician ________ a white dove out of his empty hat.
questions.explanation: 感官动词 watch 的句型用法："watch sb. do sth."（强调目睹了动作的全过程），此处需接不带 to 的动词原形 pull。

questions.question: If I ________ in your position, I would discuss the issue openly with my parents.
questions.explanation: 第二类虚拟条件句（Second Conditional）：表示与现在事实相反的假设，条件句中的 be 动词不论主语单复数，标准语法规范一律使用 were。

questions.question: Having lived in Singapore for many years, Mrs Gomez is accustomed to ________ spicy food.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配："be accustomed to doing sth." 相当于 "be used to doing sth."，意为“习惯于做某事”，其中的 to 为介词，后接动名词 eating。

questions.question: Every student in the hall ________ quietly for the guest speaker to arrive right now.
questions.explanation: "Every + 单数名词" 作主语时，谓语动词用单数；时间状语 "right now" 明确提示用现在进行时，故填 is waiting。
